facts.big: Is the tip included? · How much should I leave?
facts.label: Entender a gorjeta
facts.sub: Pergunte Is the tip included? e How much should I leave? Entenda Fifteen to twenty percent. Diga a conta com The bill is twenty dollars e o valor com I leave four dollars.

facts.label: Gorjetas importam
facts.sub: Nos EUA, os garçons recebem salários baixos e dependem das gorjetas. Por isso, deixar de quinze a vinte por cento da conta é o costume em restaurantes.

facts.label: Como calcular
facts.sub: Uma regra simples: dobre o imposto, ou calcule dez por cento e some a metade. Para uma conta de vinte dólares, quatro dólares são vinte por cento.

pages.title: How much to leave? · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning in a cozy cafe in Chicago. Theo finishes his coffee and a warm croissant. The waitress, Mia, has served him with a smile. He raises his hand and asks for the check. Mia brings it quickly in a small folder. Theo reads the numbers and thinks about the tip.
“Here is your check. Thank you for coming!” says Mia. “Thank you. Is the tip included?” says Theo. “No, the tip is not included.” says Mia.
